messages.subject: parameter estimates
parts:
Hi Nick, 

I just ran an unconstrained DEC analysis on the example Psychotria data. I am comparing the results to your 2014 Syst. Bio. paper and it appears that I obtained different estimates for d, e, and LnL. Any thoughts on what might be causing these discrepancies?

Chris

messages.author: 7e23f74583d1784d
messages.subject: Re: parameter estimates
parts:
Hey Nick, 

Never mind I figured it out. I was using a different value for max areas. 

Chris
